Represent an ensemble-manifest emission

Source: R/classes.R
survkit_manifest.Rd

A self-contained, manifest-compatible emission for orchestra composition: a draw ensemble of parameters and predicted survival, with provenance. Produced by as_survkit_manifest(); convertible to a pesto_ensemble_manifest when that contract is available (see the manifest emitter).

Usage

survkit_manifest(
  params = data.frame(),
  outputs = NULL,
  time_grid = numeric(0),
  method = character(0),
  emitter_version = character(0),
  seed = NA_integer_
)

Arguments

params

Data frame of parameter draws (n_draw rows).

outputs

Data frame of predicted survival draws on a time grid.

time_grid

Numeric vector of evaluation times.

method

Character method name.

emitter_version

Character package version that emitted the manifest.

seed

Integer RNG seed.

Value

A survkit_manifest S7 object.

See also

as_survkit_manifest(), which constructs this object.

Examples

fit <- survkit(survival::Surv(time, status) ~ age, survival::lung,
               method = "weibull")
man <- as_survkit_manifest(fit, n_draws = 50L)
man@method
#> [1] "weibull"
